examples.text_en: A large wingspan helps this bird fly far.
examples.text_zh: 宽大的翼展帮助这种鸟飞得很远。

examples.text_en: We measured the wingspan of the small bird.
examples.text_zh: 我们量了那只小鸟的翼展。

examples.text_en: She put a winkle in the small box.
examples.text_zh: 她把一只滨螺放进了小盒子里。

examples.text_en: We ate a winkle at the old sea town.
examples.text_zh: 我们在那个古老的海边小镇吃了滨螺。

examples.text_en: They winnow the grain in the open air.
examples.text_zh: 他们在露天里扬谷。

examples.text_en: We must winnow the good from the bad here.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须在这里把好的和坏的分选出来。

examples.text_en: She had a winsome look and a kind voice.
examples.text_zh: 她容貌迷人，声音和善。

examples.text_en: The young girl gave a winsome little song.
examples.text_zh: 那个小女孩唱了一首迷人的小曲。

examples.text_en: The police tried to wiretap the old house.
examples.text_zh: 警方试图对这栋老房子进行窃听。

examples.text_en: They will wiretap the line for a short time.
examples.text_zh: 他们会对这条线路窃听一小段时间。

examples.text_en: A wispy line of light was over the town.
examples.text_zh: 一缕缥缈的光线悬在小镇上空。

examples.text_en: Her wispy hair moved in the light air.
examples.text_zh: 她细薄的头发在微风中轻轻飘动。

examples.text_en: She gave a wistful look at the old house.
examples.text_zh: 她带着渴望的神情望着那栋老房子。

examples.text_en: He felt wistful about his young life.
examples.text_zh: 他怀念起自己年轻时的生活。

examples.text_en: They should not withhold the truth from the court.
examples.text_zh: 他们不该向法庭隐瞒真相。

examples.text_en: He chose to withhold his answer for a time.
examples.text_zh: 他选择暂时不给出答复。

examples.text_en: His witticism made the whole group feel good.
examples.text_zh: 他的一句妙语让整群人都开心起来。

examples.text_en: She told a fine witticism at the long table.
examples.text_zh: 她在长桌旁讲了一句绝妙的俏皮话。

examples.text_en: He was a witty man with a good mind.
examples.text_zh: 他是个头脑好、说话诙谐的人。

examples.text_en: Her witty words made the children happy.
examples.text_zh: 她诙谐的话语让孩子们很开心。

examples.text_en: The old book was about magic and wizardry.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书讲的是魔法与巫术。

examples.text_en: People once feared the wizardry of the old world.
examples.text_zh: 人们曾畏惧旧世界的巫术。

examples.text_en: The long heat will wizen his old face.
examples.text_zh: 长久的酷热会让他苍老的脸干枯。

examples.text_en: Age began to wizen the poor old man.
examples.text_zh: 岁月开始让这位可怜的老人变得干瘪。

examples.text_en: The wizened old man sat by the fire.
examples.text_zh: 那位干瘦的老人坐在火边。

examples.text_en: Her wizened face was full of old pain.
examples.text_zh: 她干枯的脸上写满陈年的痛苦。

examples.text_en: The old table began to wobble at once.
examples.text_zh: 那张旧桌子立刻开始摇晃。

examples.text_en: We felt the small boat wobble in the dark sea.
examples.text_zh: 我们感到小船在漆黑的海上摇晃。

examples.text_en: Wollongong is a city in the south of Australia.
examples.text_zh: 伍伦贡是澳大利亚南部的一座城市。

examples.text_en: They took a long train to Wollongong last week.
examples.text_zh: 上周他们乘长途火车去了伍伦贡。

examples.text_en: As was his wont, he left without a word.
examples.text_zh: 他照例一声不响地走了。

examples.text_en: She rose early, as was her old wont.
examples.text_zh: 她像往常一样早早起身。

examples.text_en: He tried to woo her with kind words.
examples.text_zh: 他试着用温柔的话语追求她。

examples.text_en: The young man hoped to woo the girl.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人希望能赢得那个女孩的芳心。

examples.text_en: The old book had a fine woodcut on each page.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书每一页都有一幅精美的木刻。

examples.text_en: He made a woodcut of the small town.
examples.text_zh: 他为这个小镇刻了一幅木刻画。

examples.text_en: The woolly coat kept her warm all day.
examples.text_zh: 那件羊毛外套让她暖和了一整天。

examples.text_en: His woolly hair was dark and long.
examples.text_zh: 他蓬乱的头发又黑又长。

examples.text_en: The whole workforce came to the meeting today.
examples.text_zh: 今天全体职工都来参加了会议。

examples.text_en: They need a big workforce for this work.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作他们需要大量劳动力。

examples.text_en: His workload was too much for one man.
examples.text_zh: 他的工作量对一个人来说太重了。

examples.text_en: The new plan cut the whole workload in half.
examples.text_zh: 新方案把整个工作量减去了一半。

examples.text_en: The workman built the old door by hand.
examples.text_zh: 这位工匠手工做了那扇旧门。

examples.text_en: A good workman is hard to find today.
examples.text_zh: 如今很难找到好工匠。

examples.text_en: The workman held the workpiece with one hand.
examples.text_zh: 工匠用一只手扶着工件。

examples.text_en: The machine cut the workpiece into two parts.
examples.text_zh: 机器把工件切成了两部分。

examples.text_en: The city holds free workshops for young people.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市为年轻人举办免费的讨论会。

examples.text_en: We joined two workshops about art and music.
examples.text_zh: 我们参加了两个关于艺术和音乐的研讨会。

examples.text_en: The world-wide market changed the small town.
examples.text_zh: 全球性的市场改变了这个小镇。

examples.text_en: Her story became world-wide news that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年她的故事成了全球性的新闻。

examples.text_en: He gave up worldly things to live alone.
examples.text_zh: 他舍弃世俗之物，独自生活。

examples.text_en: She had a worldly view of the whole case.
examples.text_zh: 她对整个案件持有一种世俗的看法。

examples.text_en: A white wraith moved through the dark hall.
examples.text_zh: 一个白色的幽灵穿过昏暗的大厅。

examples.text_en: He saw a wraith in the old house.
examples.text_zh: 他在那栋老房子里看见一个幽灵。

examples.text_en: The wrangler was always ready for a fight.
examples.text_zh: 这个爱争论的人随时准备吵一场。

examples.text_en: A wrangler sat by the fire all night.
examples.text_zh: 一个牧人整夜坐在火边。

examples.text_en: His wrath was hard to face that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天他的愤怒让人难以面对。

examples.text_en: She could not hide her wrath at his words.
examples.text_zh: 听到他的话，她无法掩饰自己的愤怒。

examples.text_en: The storm will wreak its wrath on the town.
examples.text_zh: 风暴将把怒火发泄在这座小镇上。

examples.text_en: He wanted to wreak his pain on the old wall.
examples.text_zh: 他想把痛苦发泄在那面旧墙上。

examples.text_en: Green light seemed to wreathe the old house.
examples.text_zh: 绿光仿佛环绕着那栋老房子。

examples.text_en: A smile began to wreathe her face.
examples.text_zh: 她脸上渐渐绽开一圈笑意。

examples.text_en: They found the wreckage of the small boat.
examples.text_zh: 他们找到了那条小船失事后的残骸。

examples.text_en: The wreckage was all over the dark field.
examples.text_zh: 残骸散落在昏暗的田野上。

examples.text_en: A small wren was in the open field.
examples.text_zh: 一只小鹪鹩在开阔的田野里。

examples.text_en: We saw a wren near the old house.
examples.text_zh: 我们在老房子附近看见一只鹪鹩。

examples.text_en: The two young men began to wrestle.
examples.text_zh: 两个年轻人开始摔跤。

examples.text_en: He had to wrestle with the hard choice.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不为这个艰难的选择苦苦挣扎。

examples.text_en: The wretched man had no home and no food.
examples.text_zh: 这个可怜的人没有家，也没有食物。

examples.text_en: She felt wretched after the long night.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的夜晚过后，她感到十分凄惨。

examples.text_en: The wright made a fine door by hand.
examples.text_zh: 这位工匠手工做了一扇精美的门。

examples.text_en: A good wright can work with wood and earth.
examples.text_zh: 好工匠能加工木头和泥土。

examples.text_en: The court gave a writ to the two men.
examples.text_zh: 法院向那两个人发出了令状。

examples.text_en: A writ was sent to the old company.
examples.text_zh: 一份令状被送到了那家老公司。

examples.text_en: The gate was wrought with great skill and care.
examples.text_zh: 这扇大门制作得极其精巧用心。

examples.text_en: This fine box was wrought by hand long ago.
examples.text_zh: 这个精美的盒子是许久以前手工制成的。

examples.text_en: He gave a wry look and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他做了个歪嘴的表情，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: Her wry words made the group feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 她那歪曲的话语让大家都感到不快。

examples.text_en: The doctor took an x-ray of his left hand.
examples.text_zh: 医生给他的左手拍了张 X 光片。

examples.text_en: They used an x-ray to see the broken bone.
examples.text_zh: 他们用 X 射线查看断裂的骨头。

examples.text_en: The xenophobe would not speak to the new people.
examples.text_zh: 这个仇外的人不愿和新来的人说话。

examples.text_en: People called him a xenophobe for his words.
examples.text_zh: 因为他的言论，人们叫他仇外者。

examples.text_en: Xenophobia can make a whole town turn away.
examples.text_zh: 排外情绪能让整座城镇都拒人于外。

examples.text_en: They spoke against xenophobia in the city.
examples.text_zh: 他们在城里发声反对排外情绪。

examples.text_en: A xerophyte can live with very little water.
examples.text_zh: 旱生植物用极少的水就能存活。

examples.text_en: This xerophyte lives in the hot land.
examples.text_zh: 这种旱生植物生长在炎热的土地上。

examples.text_en: Please xerox this page for the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 请把这一页给全组人各复印一份。

examples.text_en: She will xerox the old book for us.
examples.text_zh: 她会为我们复印那本旧书。

examples.text_en: The old yardstick was long and made of wood.
examples.text_zh: 那把旧码尺很长，是木制的。

examples.text_en: Money is not the only yardstick of success.
examples.text_zh: 金钱不是衡量成功的唯一准绳。

examples.text_en: She used fine yarn to make the warm coat.
examples.text_zh: 她用上好的纱线织了那件暖和的外套。

examples.text_en: The old man told a long yarn about the sea.
examples.text_zh: 老人讲了一个关于大海的长故事。

examples.text_en: The small boat began to yaw in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 小船在黑暗中开始偏航。

examples.text_en: The sea made the boat yaw to one side.
examples.text_zh: 海面使小船向一侧偏航。

examples.text_en: The yearly meeting will be held in the city.
examples.text_zh: 一年一度的会议将在城里举行。

examples.text_en: We make a yearly visit to the old town.
examples.text_zh: 我们每年都会去那座古镇一趟。

examples.text_en: We heard the yelp of a dog at night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里我们听到一只狗尖厉的叫声。

examples.text_en: A high yelp came from the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 一声尖利的急叫从昏暗的房间里传出。

examples.text_en: The yeoman worked the land with his own hand.
examples.text_zh: 这位自耕农亲手耕种自己的土地。

examples.text_en: A yeoman was free to work his own land.
examples.text_zh: 自耕农可以自由耕种自己的土地。

examples.text_en: The yielding earth was easy to work.
examples.text_zh: 松软的土地容易耕种。

examples.text_en: He had a yielding heart and a kind voice.
examples.text_zh: 他心地柔顺，声音和善。

examples.text_en: The old yoke was heavy on his back.
examples.text_zh: 那副旧轭压在他背上很沉。

examples.text_en: They were under the yoke of a hard rule.
examples.text_zh: 他们处在严苛规定的束缚之下。

examples.text_en: The yokel was new to the big city.
examples.text_zh: 这个乡巴佬对大城市还很陌生。

examples.text_en: People called him a yokel from the small town.
examples.text_zh: 人们叫他来自小镇的乡巴佬。

examples.text_en: The youngster ran across the open field.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人跑过开阔的田野。

examples.text_en: A young youngster asked about the old war.
examples.text_zh: 一个少年问起了那场旧战争。

examples.text_en: She still has a youthful face and voice.
examples.text_zh: 她仍有着年轻的面容和嗓音。

examples.text_en: His youthful life was full of hope and work.
examples.text_zh: 他年轻时的生活充满希望和劳作。

examples.text_en: The food at the party was very yummy.
examples.text_zh: 聚会上的食物非常美味。

examples.text_en: She made a yummy meal for the children.
examples.text_zh: 她给孩子们做了一顿可口的饭。

examples.text_en: The zealot would not hear any other view.
examples.text_zh: 这个狂热者听不进任何别的观点。

examples.text_en: He was a zealot for the old and simple life.
examples.text_zh: 他热切追求古老简朴的生活。

examples.text_en: Their zealotry made a hard time for the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们的狂热给小镇带来了一段艰难的日子。

examples.text_en: The old book spoke against zealotry and hate.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书反对狂热与仇恨。

examples.text_en: She was zealous in her work all her life.
examples.text_zh: 她一生都对工作充满热忱。

examples.text_en: The zealous young man wanted to change the world.
examples.text_zh: 这个热心的年轻人想要改变世界。

examples.text_en: The sun was at its zenith over the town.
examples.text_zh: 太阳正位于小镇上方的顶点。

examples.text_en: His power was at its zenith that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年他的权力达到了顶峰。

examples.text_en: A light zephyr moved through the open door.
examples.text_zh: 一阵轻柔的和风从敞开的门吹进来。

examples.text_en: The zephyr was fine and full of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 这阵和风清爽宜人，带着海的气息。

examples.text_en: He did the work with real zest and power.
examples.text_zh: 他满怀热情和干劲地做这项工作。

examples.text_en: Her zest for life was good to see.
examples.text_zh: 她对生活的热情看在眼里令人欣慰。

examples.text_en: The zesty food made the whole meal fun.
examples.text_zh: 这风味十足的食物让整顿饭都很有趣。

examples.text_en: She had a zesty way of living and working.
examples.text_zh: 她生活和做事都充满热情。

examples.text_en: Zinc is used to keep the old wall safe.
examples.text_zh: 锌被用来保护这面旧墙。

examples.text_en: This box is made of zinc and fine wood.
examples.text_zh: 这个盒子是用锌和上好的木头制成的。

examples.text_en: She went to the city to study zoology.
examples.text_zh: 她去城里学习动物学。

examples.text_en: His book about zoology was long and clear.
examples.text_zh: 他那本关于动物学的书写得又长又清晰。

examples.text_en: The price of the old house began to zoom.
examples.text_zh: 那栋老房子的价格开始急速上涨。

examples.text_en: You can zoom in on the far wall.
examples.text_zh: 你可以把镜头拉近对准远处那面墙。
